name: daw-live-cam
description: Record your music production sessions: phone camera as a wireless cam, synced with audio captured straight from your DAW.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DAW LIVE CAM records audio from your DAW and microphone.

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: DAW LIVE CAM connects to your phone over the local network.
